title: A Systematic Review of Recent Advancements in PINN Augmented Deep Learning and Mathematical Modeling for Efficient Portfolio Management
summary: In finance, portfolio management is a traditional yet difficult problem that has drawn attention from practitioners and researchers for many years. However, there are still difficult technological problems that need to be solved. In the world of finance, managing a portfolio has never been easy. Selecting portfolios in a volatile market is made easier with the help of portfolio management.
